column1: # Game profile of Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled (Switch, update 1.0.15 = v983040)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Vicarious Visions' Alchemy engine (build name Octane), SDK 8.2.0, NVN, Havok, FMOD, Bink 2; subsdk0 is the game's own GLSLC.
# The shaders are whole GLSLC outputs in the shader .igz files of archives/shaders_nx.pak, an igArchive version 13 with LZMA blocks (shader_split.py iga_shaders),
# and 12 more in main. The game compiles 2 more at run time with its own GLSLC: captured on a device with DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE, the /glslc_capture/ rows (README.md).
# Status: plays on an AYN Thor; the memory values are the survey's guess (dm/games/profile_guess.py), not measured
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# the modules take 107 MB (main 84.4, sdk 13.0, subsdk0 9.2), more than the default 64 MB: SetHeapSize(pool − used) needs at least their size here
# The game asks for present interval 2 (30 fps) and steps its races by the time that passed: at 60 fps the race clock ran 20.43 s in 20.43 s (AYN Thor).
# Follow the display ticks so the host's frame limit picks the rate; 60 by default, the launcher's choices down to 20 and up to 120. No code patch.
# PEANUTS: On an empty save the game opens on its Language Select screen and waits for a button, before it compiles the 2 run-time shaders:
# the build's capture boot presses A every 3 s from 8 s on (AYN Thor: no capture in 75 s without, both in 15 s with it)
